# QuantumReservoirMemoryCapacity

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The maximum amount of temporal information a quantum reservoir can retain and retrieve, quantified via the rank of the Fisher information matrix of its state ensemble. Directly determines the practical utility of quantum reservoir computers for time-series prediction in TCC/iNEST applications, guiding hardware design choices.
